title: Select activity sources and operations with refreshable tracing rules
goal: Choose sources, operations, listener names and local/global scope through tracing configuration when manual listener wiring becomes repetitive.

selectionNotes: Rules select registered listeners; AddTracing alone is not a telemetry exporter.
Local sources belong to their DI factory; new ActivitySource creates a global source.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The primary route uses .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is evidence, not an exact installation requirement.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical sample language mode; preview language syntax is not required.

packageAssets: Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics implementation and tracing configuration come from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App; the source factory contract is in the .NET 11 framework.
platforms: Desktop/server .NET 11; executed on Windows x64. Browser/WASI/mobile excluded.
prerequisites: Console project: net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable/implicit usings enabled and FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App. The combined evidence sample also references a logging generator, which tracing itself does not require.
constraints: Rules select registered listeners; AddTracing alone is not a telemetry exporter.
Local sources belong to their DI factory; new ActivitySource creates a global source.
No external account, optional workload, rendering integration, provisioning or unverified older-target package route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 compilation/execution; GA reconciliation pending. No experimental API opt-in.

evidence.scope: Actual previous-release comparison: Real sampled/stopped records, excluded operation/source/global scope, existing-source false/true/false configuration reload and raw RefreshSources attach/detach.

humanProof.scope: Managed shared API and loopback/in-process claims need no Human-only proof. External services/exporters, web adapters, native/browser hosts, trimming and GA behavior are not claimed.
